changeMinAcceptedETH(uint256).details: Changes minimum accepted ETH amount by the Treasury.

params._minAcceptedETH: New minimum accepted ETH amount. #if_succeeds {:msg "Min accepted ETH"} minAcceptedETH > 0 && minAcceptedETH <= type(uint96).max;

params.amounts: Set of corresponding amounts deposited on behalf of each service Id. #if_succeeds {:msg "we do not touch the owners balance"} old(ETHOwned) == ETHOwned; #if_succeeds {:msg "updated ETHFromServices"} old(ETHFromServices) + msg.value + old(ETHOwned) <= type(uint96).max && ETHFromServices == old(ETHFromServices) + msg.value ==> address(this).balance == ETHFromServices + ETHOwned; #if_succeeds {:msg "any paused"} paused == 1 || paused == 2;

depositTokenForOLAS(address,uint256,addr.details: Allows the depository to deposit LP tokens for OLAS.

params.account: Account address making a deposit of LP tokens for OLAS.
params.olasMintAmount: Amount of OLAS token issued. #if_succeeds {:msg "we do not touch the total eth balance"} old(address(this).balance) == address(this).balance; #if_succeeds {:msg "any paused"} paused == 1 || paused == 2; #if_succeeds {:msg "OLAS balances"} IToken(olas).balanceOf(msg.sender) == old(IToken(olas).balanceOf(msg.sender)) + olasMintAmount; #if_succeeds {:msg "OLAS supply"} IToken(olas).totalSupply() == old(IToken(olas).totalSupply()) + olasMintAmount;
params.tokenAmount: Token amount to get OLAS for.

disableToken(address).details: Disables an LP token from the ability to bond for OLAS.

drainServiceSlashedFunds().details: Drains slashed funds from the service registry.

returns.amount: Drained amount. #if_succeeds {:msg "correct update total eth balance"} address(this).balance == old(address(this).balance) + amount; #if_succeeds {:msg "conservation law"} ETHFromServices + ETHOwned == old(ETHFromServices + ETHOwned) + amount; if_succeeds {:msg "slashed funds check"} IServiceRegistry(ITokenomics(tokenomics).serviceRegistry()).slashedFunds() >= minAcceptedETH ==> old(IServiceRegistry(ITokenomics(tokenomics).serviceRegistry()).slashedFunds()) == amount;

enableToken(address).details: Enables an LP token to be bonded for OLAS.

isEnabled(address).details: Gets information about token being enabled for bonding.

rebalanceTreasury(uint256).details: Re-balances treasury funds to account for the treasury reward for a specific epoch.

returns.success: True, if the function execution is successful. #if_succeeds {:msg "we do not touch the total eth balance"} old(address(this).balance) == address(this).balance; #if_succeeds {:msg "conservation law"} old(ETHFromServices + ETHOwned) == ETHFromServices + ETHOwned; #if_succeeds {:msg "unpaused"} paused == 1;

withdraw(address,uint256,address).details: Allows owner to transfer tokens from treasury reserves to a specified address.

params.tokenAmount: Token amount to get reserves from.

returns.success: True if the transfer is successful. #if_succeeds {:msg "we do not touch the balance of developers"} old(ETHFromServices) == ETHFromServices; #if_succeeds {:msg "updated ETHOwned"} token == ETH_TOKEN_ADDRESS ==> ETHOwned == old(ETHOwned) - tokenAmount; #if_succeeds {:msg "ETH balance"} token == ETH_TOKEN_ADDRESS ==> address(this).balance == old(address(this).balance) - tokenAmount; #if_succeeds {:msg "updated token reserves"} token != ETH_TOKEN_ADDRESS ==> mapTokenReserves[token] == old(mapTokenReserves[token]) - tokenAmount; #if_succeeds {:msg "any paused"} paused == 1 || paused == 2;

withdrawToAccount(address,uint256,uint25.details: Withdraws ETH and / or OLAS amounts to the requested account address.

returns.success: True if the function execution is successful. #if_succeeds {:msg "we do not touch the owners balance"} old(ETHOwned) == ETHOwned; #if_succeeds {:msg "updated ETHFromServices"} accountRewards > 0 && ETHFromServices >= accountRewards ==> ETHFromServices == old(ETHFromServices) - accountRewards; #if_succeeds {:msg "ETH balance"} accountRewards > 0 && ETHFromServices >= accountRewards ==> address(this).balance == old(address(this).balance) - accountRewards; #if_succeeds {:msg "updated OLAS balances"} accountTopUps > 0 ==> IToken(olas).balanceOf(account) == old(IToken(olas).balanceOf(account)) + accountTopUps; #if_succeeds {:msg "OLAS supply"} IToken(olas).totalSupply() == old(IToken(olas).totalSupply()) + accountTopUps; #if_succeeds {:msg "unpaused"} paused == 1;

depositServiceDonationsETH(uint256[],uin.notice: Each provided service Id must be deployed at least once, otherwise its components and agents are undefined.If a specific service is terminated with agent Ids being updated, incentives will be issued to its old         configuration component / agent owners until the service is re-deployed when new agent Ids are accounted for.

depositTokenForOLAS(address,uint256,addr.notice: Only depository contract can call this function.

withdrawToAccount(address,uint256,uint25.notice: Only dispenser contract can call this function.Reentrancy guard is on a dispenser side.Zero account address is not possible, since the dispenser contract interacts with msg.sender.
